youtube.title: Why Did a Pope Delete 10 Days From 1582? #Shorts
youtube.description: Easter is tied to the spring equinox, and by 1582 it was drifting out of place. So Pope Gregory the Thirteenth deleted the extra days: in Catholic countries, Thursday the 4th of October was followed by Friday the 15th. The calendar on your phone still runs on his rule, and it is still off by about 27 seconds a year, one day in about three thousand years. Full episode on the channel. #Shorts #history #calendar #pope #thehiddenwhy
